text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 1:1 (approximately 1.000:1), target canvas 1254 × 1254 pixels.

Square photographic full-body character turnaround with three equal vertical panels: front view, exact left-facing 90-degree profile, direct back view with no face visible. One fictional adult Rae, age 38, with fair freckled skin, green-hazel eyes, short copper-auburn side-parted bob, defined adult cheekbones, narrow straight nose, fine expression lines, rose lips and tiny silver hoop earrings.  Same figure rotating, neutral stance, relaxed arms, complete hands, all hair and shoes visible, crowns and soles aligned on common level ground. Balanced natural adult proportions with long legs, no stretched neck or miniature head. Wardrobe in every view: gray-beige double-breasted suit jacket with dark buttons, matching wide straight trousers, pale blue pinstripe shirt, navy tie and black loafers. Neutral closed lips. Plain matte cool-gray studio wall and gray floor, soft cool blue-gray daylight and even fill, subtle fine film grain, real pores, fine facial hair, matte skin and real fabric weave. Photographic live-action casting reference, no stylized 3D, no wax skin, heavy retouching, strong warm tint, drama lighting, text, labels or watermark.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。
